title: Maximum Points You Can Obtain from Cards
summary: Given an array of card points and an integer k, select exactly k cards from either end of the array to maximize the sum of the points.
statement: Given an array of card points and an integer k, select exactly k cards from either end of the array to maximize the sum of the points. Return the highest possible score.
constraints: Take exactly k cards, one at a time, only from either end.
hints: Any valid outcome takes some prefix and the remaining cards from the suffix.
Begin with all k from the left.
Move one choice at a time from the left boundary to the right boundary.
The k+1 prefix/suffix splits cover every possible end-taking result.
editorial: The k+1 prefix/suffix splits cover every possible end-taking result.

tests.explanation: Taking six and the two rightmost cards yields twelve.
Any two end cards total four.
